value_or_null.description: All constituent information is secondhand from this exact secondary review. Four RCTs,11articles,1042reported participants are not newly verified original trials or patients. Existing Larocca canonical report and shared Palumbo arms remain unchanged.

Citation remains2021Issue9, delivered review edited inIssue1of2023, no change to conclusions. Main search14June2021 differs from living amendment last search14December2022/no new studies. Appendix search strategies headed2019; history also literally says14December2014. Do not silently repair these dates or claim a current2026search. No published protocol according to source.

RRs are aspirin relative to VKA/LMWH/DOAC here, not the inverse directions in Rutjes2020. DVT and PE assessed separately, not Rutjes symptomatic VTE. Different methods/uncertainty/GRADE are source-specific and cannot be averaged as independent replication.

All retained aspirin comparison relative-effect confidence intervals include1, some extremely wide. PE aspirin/LMWH printedP.05 withCI.97to61.44 does not establishP<.05. No superiority, equivalence, noninferiority, absence of bleeding risk or tumor/survival benefit established.

Review reported1042 uses study totals including667Palumbo versus659dosed; do not equate full enrolled versus analyzed.781aspirin/LMWH=396/385 includes342Larocca plus439Palumbo;440aspirin/VKA and repeated followups share patients.2yearPalumboLMWH denominator220 differs from6month219; preserve both without silently repairing original flow. No summed pairwise unique N.

Six-month pooled mortality and major bleeding include double-zero Larocca trials with no estimable RR, so only Palumbo estimates these ratios. Summary absolute risks use assumed0.1%control risk where observed zero, not observed control rates. Very low sparse-event evidence cannot establish safety or equivalence.

TiMM recruited10 but aspirin/apixaban randomized standard-risk comparison is4versus4;2additionalhigh-riskapixaban patients excluded from that contrast. Do not assignN10or6apixaban to the analyzed comparison. Campos18/5explicitly reported in this review, not inferred from ratios or transferred back to Rutjes.

Sayar minorbleed2/4ASAversus0/4apixaban,RR5CI.31to79.94; no DVT/PE/majorbleed eitherarm in body, while summary7 labels some outcomes not reported. Sensitivity adds Campos, total31=22ASA/9DOAC;1ASA DVT and1ASAmajorbleed each use continuity-correctedRR.95CI.04to20.33 despite one observed event only in ASA. Do not recalculate a raw-rate RR or infer benefit from pointestimate<1. PEdoublezero notestimable.

Rutjes2020 CAL03 says no majorbleeding in eitherCampos arm and does not give explicit outcome Ns. This review Analysis8.3 reports1/18ASAversus0/5rivaroxaban majorbleed. Preserve source disagreement and require original abstract/full report before adjudication; do not revise frozen CAL03 or pool both as independent trials.

Source inconsistencies: narrative says Campos/Sayar sequence generation not reported whereas Figure3/tables judge low; summary7 calls DVT/majorbleeding not reported while body reports zero events; Analysis7.1 right favours label saysLMWH despiteDOAC comparison. Summary2 DVT/PE footnotes appear copied/inconsistent with table. Preserve literal labels and use explicit outcome/column data, no silent source repair.

Larocca characteristics call402 patients thalidomide-regimen despite lenalidomide study; Sayar regimen percentages literal10%,70%,100% exceed a mutually exclusive total. Not reconciled or turned into patient counts, and no assumed randomized balance from these descriptions.

All trials openlabel. Review judgments of low detection risk are author inference despite no masking report; Palumbo selective-reporting high for unreported toxicity requiring prophylaxis interruption. Palumbo attrition judged low here versus high in Rutjes. SourceGRADE verylow for listed main outcomes, source discussion low-or-verylow generic, not new editorial grade or scientific approval.

Six-month and two-year outcome windows differ from median2.4to3.6month drug exposure;2years corresponds Palumbo median24.9months, not repeated treatment duration or new people. Two-year major/minorbleeding unreported, DOAC mortality unreported, no fullSAE dataset. No imputation of missing events aszero. Complete-case primary and reviewITTlabels remain distinct.

Newly diagnosed selected ambulatory myeloma on specific regimens, no establishedVTE/other anticoagulation indication; TiMM some regimens not IMiD uniform. No placebo/no-prophylaxis comparison establishes absolute aspirin efficacy here. Prevention/supportivecare not anticancer therapy, current prescription or broad all-myeloma certainty. Historical guidelines/background mechanisms remain context.

ASH supported review to inform guidelines; no internal support listed. FS/MBdeclare conflicts without elaboration here; guideline roles LKH/HS/EAAdeclared. Constituent trial personalfees/researchfunding secondhand, Larocca foundation and SayarNIHRsupport recorded; no no-conflict inference or independent supplied-product check. Raw underlyingdata/protocols/currentintegrity notchecked.
